An Outstanding Bright and Most Spacious 4 Bedroom (4 Bath) End Terrace Property with option to convert the large attic and which provides an excellent 155 Sq Meters currently of First Class and Pristine Energy Efficient Accomodation with its A3 Ber Energy Rating and with a beautiful landscaped westerly facing private Rear Garden and Private Driveway to side for parking. The Property is located over Ground Floor, 1st Floor and 2nd Floor and enjoys Gas Fired Central Heating with all modern Double Glazed PVC Exterior doors and Windows. The Location of the Property is outstanding offering the discerning buyer an amazing choice of living conveniently to all major services and facilities akin to a busy modern lifestyle and yet also convenient to the quieter idyllic lifestyle offered by the beautiful countryside of nearby County Kildare
This stunning,  A3-rated 3-storey family home  spanning 155 sq meters, but with option to convert the large attic into a 5th Bedroom, currently offers 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms. Combining exceptional energy efficiency with bright, spacious interiors, it features a private, westerly landscaped garden, two-car parking spaces on private driveway, and an idyllic location on the periphery of Lucan village, minutes from the M50, N7, N4 and Phoenix Park making connectivity a key advantage of this property. 

Property Overview

Built to an exceptional standard , this large three-storey family home perfectly marries the conveniences of modern, energy-efficient living adjacent to all the amazing services and facilities which a family require for convenience,  with the tranquility of a natural, village-based lifestyle in the nearby historic Lucan Village which the River Liffey flows through. Offering bright, light-filled and well proportioned accommodation throughout, this property provides an idyllic retreat for growing families. 

Key Features

Energy Efficiency: Exceptional A3 BER rating, featuring state-of-the-art insulation and economic heating systems for incredibly low running costs. 
Bedrooms & Bathrooms: Four generously proportioned, bright bedrooms spread across the upper floors, and three high-quality, modern bathrooms.
Interior Finish: Finished to an impeccable standard with premium, high-quality sanitary ware in all bathrooms and a stunning, contemporary kitchen.[1, 2]
Outdoor Space: A professionally landscaped, westerly-orientated rear garden provides the perfect suntrap for evening relaxation and alfresco dining. Includes secure side access.
Parking: Private off-street parking for two cars to the side.
Side access located in quiet cul de sac
Location & Lifestyle
Superbly positioned on the peaceful periphery of the picturesque Lucan Village, where the beautiful River Liffey flows right by your doorstep. While the setting is idylllic and reflective, it boasts unbeatable connectivity. Within a 10-minute drive of the M50, N7, and N4, residents have quick access to Dublin Airport, Dublin City Centre,  Liffey Valley Shopping Centre, and so many other services and facilities too numerous to mention.
The area is also a dream for families, offering a wealth of local amenities including excellent schools, local shops, cafes, and restaurants. For outdoor recreation, you are surrounded by stunning green spaces, including Griffeen Valley Park, Vesey Park, and the expansive Phoenix Park.
Nearby amenities include Airlie Park (5 mins walk) with two playgrounds for younger and older children separately plus All Weather Pitches, Tennis Courts, Cricket Ground
Tandys Lane Park only 5 mins walk away also with two playgrounds.  
Viewing of this exceptional pristine property is very highly recommended by appointment with the Agent Brid Feely MIPAV on 0872052649
